description: AGSC-01-42: the .diagram grammar and the SVG it compiles to are pinned from 1.1. Case one compiles a source that uses all twelve statements (canvas, label, region, box, circle, arrow with and without via, line, bar, path, text, cross, note) for the slug pinned; the expected bytes are the compiled document and every figure in them follows from the rule: for example the arrow from a to b is the segment between the centres (90,80) and (250,80) clipped to the borders of the two rectangles (140,80) and (200,80) and drawn 4 px inside each, M144 80 L196 80; the arrow from b to c leaves b at (250,100), passes the waypoint (250,120) and ends 4 px short of the bounding square of the circle, L115 153.8. Cases two to four are refusals, each AGSC-E412 and no SVG: an unknown statement, two accented elements, and acc with thick on one statement, which would write stroke-width twice and is not well-formed XML. The first case is accepted by the 1.0.1 engine byte for byte; the last is accepted by it too, which is why the rule refuses it.

cases.name: all-twelve-statements
cases.source:
# a diagram that uses every statement
canvas 460 260
label "Pinned diagram"
region zone 20 40 420 190 "Trust boundary"
box a 40 60 100 40 "Client" acc
box b 200 60 100 40 "Gateway|node" dashed
circle c 90 160 25 "DB"
arrow a b
arrow b c via=250,120 dashed
line 20 235 440 235 dashed
bar 300 150 100 thick
path "M330 170 L380 190" arrow
text 400 215 "Notes" size=12 right
cross 420 100
note "A pinned diagram."
